Guideline: Target GTK 4.16+ and libadwaita 1.6+ via submodules/gtk4-rs and relm4
Description: Yolo UI targets modern GTK 4.16 and libadwaita 1.6 CSS custom properties (--accent-bg-color, --window-bg-color, --card-bg-color)
Do: Use adw::Application, adw::ApplicationWindow and Relm4 component architecture
Don't: Use deprecated GTK 3 APIs, GtkDialog or legacy @define-color overrides when CSS variables exist

Guideline: Load yolo-emit GTK4 stylesheet via CssProvider
Description: crates/yolo-emit (--target gtk) generates libadwaita 1.6+ CSS variables and .m3-tonal / .m3-outlined / .m3-filled classes
Do: Load the generated gtk.css with gtk::CssProvider and register it on gdk::Display::default()
Don't: Hardcode inline Pango color markup or per-widget CSS providers on every row

Guideline: Prefer adaptive libadwaita widgets over raw GTK containers
Description: catalog/conversion.toml maps M3 NavigationSplitView to AdwNavigationSplitView, BottomSheet to AdwBottomSheet, Dialog to AdwDialog, and Toast to AdwToastOverlay
Do: Use AdwHeaderBar, AdwNavigationSplitView, AdwPreferencesGroup, AdwActionRow and AdwAlertDialog
Don't: Build non-responsive fixed GtkPaned layouts that break on narrow/mobile widths

Guideline: Use GtkListView + SignalListItemFactory for large lists
Description: GtkListBox creates a widget for every row upfront; GtkListView recycles row widgets over a gio::ListModel
Do: Use GtkListBox with .boxed-list only for short static settings groups (<20 rows) and GtkListView for dynamic data
Apply semantic CSS classes with widget.add_css_class("title-2") or "numeric"
Don't: Override font sizes in points with Pango attributes on standard UI labels

Guideline: Use Relm4 MVU components for reactive state
Description: submodules/relm4 provides #[relm4::component] macro with view! DSL, typed Input/Output messages and async Command futures
Do: Structure complex GTK4 windows into Relm4 SimpleComponent or Component units
Don't: Nest deeply cloned Rc<RefCell<...>> signal handlers across 500-line build_ui functions
Code Good: #[relm4::component] impl SimpleComponent for AppModel { view! { adw::Window { ... } } }

Guideline: Set GtkAccessible properties on icon-only controls
Description: GTK4 implements AT-SPI accessibility natively via AccessibleRole and Property::Label
Do: Call button.update_property(&[gtk::accessible::Property::Label("Close")]) or set tooltip-text on icon buttons
Don't: Create GtkButton::from_icon_name without an accessible label or tooltip

Guideline: Use XDG Desktop Portals (FileDialog / ashpd) for sandboxing
Description: GTK 4.10+ gtk::FileDialog and ashpd use XDG portals automatically under Flatpak and Wayland
Don't: Use deprecated GtkFileChooserNative or direct host filesystem paths

Guideline: Emit GtkBuilder .ui XML + sidecar .gtk.css via yolo-migrate
Description: crates/yolo-migrator (--target gtk) compiles React/Shadcn/Tailwind TSX into GTK 4.16 + libadwaita 1.6 GtkBuilder XML
Do: Use bun ui migrate <Component.tsx> --target gtk to generate verified GtkBuilder templates
Don't: Hand-write verbose XML property tags for standard flex/card layouts
Code Good: bun ui migrate SettingsCard.tsx --target gtk --preset m3

Guideline: Inspect widget trees and live CSS with GTK_DEBUG=interactive
Description: GTK4 includes a built-in interactive Inspector for live CSS editing, accessibility role verification, and GSK render node profiling
Do: Launch apps with GTK_DEBUG=interactive or bun ui devtools gtk4 to inspect CSS variables and layout bounds
Don't: Guess widget CSS selector names without checking the GTK Inspector CSS nodes tab
Code Bad: // guessing gtk4 internal CSS node names blindly
